scope: Static source/AST only. Ref003 was still running when this review was requested; no actual reference/render pass is asserted.

J_Hu.J: Per-cell minimum of exactly nine saved dimensionless J samples. Natural sample position comes from saved model.points; not a continuous minimum.
J_Hu.Hu: Per-cell maximum absolute saved component Hu[i,J,K]=u_i,JK in 1/mm; Q1 reference Hessian is element-constant, so no quadrature index is assigned.
J_Hu.phase_extrema: Mechanism-solid, nonbody-medium and fixed-body overlay are separate. Body is excluded from nonbody-medium extrema; first saved element then first sample/component breaks ties.
J_Hu.display: Saved reference coordinates plus saved lift/fluctuation, actual scale1. Body grey overlay. Common norms between full/local panels, logJ and linear absHu.
J_Hu.CSV: All3200 saved cells, ten columns with signed winning Hu component and component indices; no new fields or mechanical evaluation.
J_Hu.energy: Not evaluated; no energy, stress-HP, pressure, contact/clamp or full-column claim.

regions.face_rays: Dashed segments connect saved finite-face witness to saved mechanism-edge witness. They are forward directional geometric lengths, not forces, contact normals with pressure, signed gaps or penetration.
regions.cut: Closed-region boundary distance includes mathematical symmetry cut; physical finite-face rays exclude it. Wording preserves this distinction.
regions.endpoint_labels: Origin, actual maximum target state and final zero are selected dynamically. Repeated targets and bisection rows remain chronological and retain distinct indices.
regions.no_hit: Saved null becomes empty CSV cell/NaN curve, never zero. Saved corner/near-corner and tie counts remain in CSV; a drawn witness is only one representative saved minimum.
regions.qualifications: Cross-region cell-union overlap was measured separately. Whole-set containment/mechanism self-overlap/pressure/contact-clamp are explicitly unqualified.
regions.display: Saved deformed coordinates at scale1 with fixed grey half-square; no geometry measurement is called by viewer.

eligibility: Both loaders require successful complete original11-target path and same-result fresh2N reference. Actual N is dynamic (currently expected12 only from completed production); source/geometry/reference ownership must be frozen by future card. Raw producer flags remainFalse.

recommendation.change: Outline the already-selected phase-extremum cells with a thin unfilled PolyCollection in both full/local panels: minJ cells only in J column, maxabsHu cells only in Hu column.
recommendation.inputs: Use existing phase_extrema element IDs and existing polygons; no extra geometry/field reduction or API call.
recommendation.labels: Use distinct line style/color for mechanism-solid vs nonbody-medium, keep grey body and original color norms, identify e/q forJ and e/component forHu. No Hu quadrature label.
recommendation.reason: This lets a reader locate the printed discrete extrema without mistaking a whole colored region for the winning cell.
